title: fix: remove leaked key incident banner
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the historical leaked-key warning from the Keys page
- Removes filtering logic used only by that banner
- Keeps publishable-key budget and direct-spending enforcement unchanged

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write enter.pollinations.ai/frontend/src/components/keys/api-key-list.tsx`
- `npm run typecheck --workspace enter.pollinations.ai`
- `npm run build:frontend --workspace enter.pollinations.ai`

Follow-up to #13338.

gist.headline: The old warning flew home
gist.blurb: The Keys page has stopped carrying a historical incident banner around like an expired sticky note. Key budgets and direct-spending safeguards remain exactly where they belong.
gist.summary: Removed the historical leaked-key incident banner and its banner-only filtering logic from the Keys page while preserving publishable-key budget and direct-spending enforcement.
gist.impact: Users managing API keys now get a cleaner Keys page without the obsolete warning, with the existing budget and spending protections unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy API key garden after an old warning placard has been carefully removed: Polli tidies the clean key-management desk while a small protected key vault and budget meter remain visibly intact. The scene should communicate that stale UI clutter is gone, not that safeguards were removed; use code-plants and flowers to reinforce healthy maintenance.
